title: Chemical Safety Assessment
description: Free Chemical Safety Assessment template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers substance information, task exposure assessment, controls.
html:

Emergency Measures

ScenarioImmediate action
SpillIsolate area, use spill kit, ventilate, report
Skin or eye contactFlush with water for at least 15 minutes, seek medical help
InhalationMove to fresh air, seek medical help
FireRaise alarm, use suitable extinguisher only if safe, evacuate
